== Quest information ==

=== Objectives ===
* Destroy the renegade [[Slave Spirit|slave spirits]] before they can harm the spirit of [[Primeval King Jahnus]].
* See Primeval King Jahnus for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* [[Ancient Artifact]]

== Walkthrough ==
{{section-stub}}
Kill the groups of Slave Spirits that approach King Jahnus. The quest fails if he dies.

==Dialogue==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; Primeval King Jahnus
:''"The ungrateful wretches! My slaves don't see what an honor it would have been to be buried alive in my tomb with me! Instead they abandoned my funeral procession and ran off, leaving me here. The imbeciles ran right into the sulfur pits where their skin melted off their bones!''
:''For an eternity, I have graciously allowed them to exist, but now they are plotting my demise. They destroyed my afterlife by trapping me in this filthy hole and yet they are out there planning revenge for the wrongs they think I have done them! They come for me now, <Player name>. Will you fight beside me and destroy these traitorous '''spirit slaves'''?"''
{{ offer dialog
| accept = My liege, the traitors will pay!
| decline = I'm supposed to care about a slave owner? Cry me a river, Jahnus.
| ask = Here they come! Destroy my '''slaves''' and drive their treasonous souls back to [[the Underworld]]!
}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Primeval King Jahnus
:''"You have served me well. Let it never be said that King Jahnus does not reward those loyal to him."''

== Notes ==
* Both this quest and its sister quest, [[Refuse the King]], give the same rewards.
* Complete this quest quickly after receiving it, otherwise you might have trouble reaching the king in time to save him from the onslaught of slaves.
* This quest is sometimes used to farm [[Dead Sword]]s, which frequently drop from warrior Slave Spirits.
